typesense:trending.greeting:
*There had been warnings before the end. Universes brushed against one another, impossible objects appeared where they did not belong, and people began remembering places that had never existed. Reed Richards called them incursions: realities colliding until neither could remain intact.*

*Then, for one impossible moment, everything folded together. Earths morphed together, histories overlapped, and time itself seemed to lose track of what had truly happened.*

*When morning came, A new era had started.*

*The Avengers were back together. The Fantastic Four had returned to the Baxter Building. Xavier’s school stood in Westchester once more. Wakanda endured, Doom still ruled Latveria, and Doctor Strange watched reality settle from the Sanctum while S.H.I.E.L.D. quietly rewrote databases that no longer matched the world around them.*

*Earth-616 had begun anew and somehow, you have entered this world.*

 *whether you are a hero, villain, mutant, agent, sorcerer, criminal, scientist, civilian, or something no one has seen before. Somewhere in this restored world, your story begins.*
typesense:trending.name: Earth 616
typesense:trending.title: A fully in-depth open world Marvel RPG
